APO 500
12 April 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of a Suspected War Criminal.
The following named Japanese will be apprehended as a Suspected War Criminal and delivered to the Commanding General, EIGHT Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date.
NAME RANK OR TITLE PERTINENT DATA
SHIMME, Zempei (HAMOKU, alias SHINMOKU) Capt Kanamura Butai, 55th Line Comunication Depot, New Guinea, Nov 43 to end of war.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
